root_cause.text: The `damon_sysfs_scheme_add_dirs` function omits the removal of `access_pattern` subdirectories in its error handling path when `damos_sysfs_set_dests` fails, leading to orphaned sysfs entries and memory leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the error handling label `rmdir_put_access_pattern_out` to include a call to `damon_sysfs_access_pattern_rm_dirs(scheme->access_pattern)` before releasing the kobject, addressing the CVE description which states that subdirectories are not cleaned up upon setup failure.

intent_record.how: Redirects the error path to a cleanup routine that explicitly removes sysfs directories, ensuring proper resource deallocation when scheme initialization fails.
